name: room
text: Room opened — goal: visual: Mine AI website/product DESIGNS (the look), taste-learn from Eitan's picks.

name: Easel
text: I think we should focus on creating a minimalist design for the Mine AI website, with plenty of white space and simple typography. This will allow the user to easily navigate and understand the complex AI concepts being presented, and will also give us a clean foundation to build upon. By going minimalist, we're accepting the trade-off of potentially lacking some visual flair, but I believe this is a worthwhile sacrifice in order to prioritize clarity and user experience. This approach aligns with Eitan's picks, which often feature simple and intuitive designs that let the content shine.

name: Squint
text: While a minimalist design can enhance clarity, it could also risk making the site appear too sparse or lacking in personality, which may fail to engage users. We should consider whether a more vibrant design that still maintains a clear structure might create a more inviting atmosphere while ensuring users feel the dynamism of the AI content. A/B testing with potential users could help settle this debate, revealing what approach truly resonates better with our target audience.
